title: Read the reviews
text: Read the reviews. I agree with Steve. I bought this dealer and after some time it only sealed about 2in. I tried recharging, for a while it only would work while charging. Now nothing. Too much money for this product.

product_metadata.title: Bag Sealer – Handheld Portable Air Lock Food Preserver, Bag Resealer
features: BAG SEALER – Air Lock Bag Sealer seals all plastic bags in a matter of seconds creating an air tight container.
PORTABLE – Air Lock Bag Resealer is a light-weight and portable bag sealer you can bring it with you camping, to the beach, and pretty much on any adventure where snacks are a must.
HEAT SEALING TECHNOLOGY: Air Lock Bag Resealer uses new micro-thermal technology to create air an air tight seal that keeps food fresher than chip clips, twist ties, and rubber bands.
COMPACT – Air Lock Bag Resealer is small and compact bag sealer that creates easy storing in your kitchen drawer.

KEEP IT FRESH – Easy to use and simple to store, the handheld portable air lock food preserver is a must for anyone with a kitchen. Don’t let your love of snacks go stale; keep it fresh with FRESHeTECH.
